title: Define the necessary-detour quantity
frozenQuestion: What exact metric-relative minimax excursion is required to reach the complete goal set along finite legal paths in the frozen S05 structural opportunity graph, and can a validated solver compute it without conflating structural opportunity, byte-exact replay, or probabilistic scheduler claims?

successSemantics.goalSet: all and only S05 terminal_code=1 complete structural nodes
successSemantics.zeroLengthSuccess: a complete start succeeds by the empty path
successSemantics.quiescent: terminal_code=2 is an unsuccessful absorbing class, never a goal
successSemantics.unreachable: no finite path to the goal set is classified unreachable, not necessary-detour
successSemantics.ties: all identity-distinct structural nodes whose values satisfy the non-strict direction-specific goal belong to the goal set; equal-value identities are exchangeable for distance, but graph identities are not collapsed
successSemantics.eventBudget: excluded from structural success because it is replay-history censoring

primaryQuantity.name: minimum_peak_excursion
primaryQuantity.absoluteBottleneck: B_D(s)=min over finite paths p from s to C of max over vertices v in p of D(v)
primaryQuantity.exactArithmetic: nonnegative integer metric numerators within a fixed family; positive family normalization constants rescale but do not change paths or necessity signs

dependentReportingForms.paper_sortedness_distance_numerator: equals adjacent_descents in the unique-value S05 corpus; not goal-identifying under ties
dependentReportingForms.emd_numerator: equals spearman_footrule under the S01 unit-mass line geometry
dependentReportingForms.normalized_forms: positive within-family rescalings of exact numerators

metrics.goalCompatibility: a proper goal distance must be zero on every complete tied-value goal; incompatible proxies may be reported only with an explicit non-distance label

schedulerQuantification.primary: existential over finite labelled S05 legal-opportunity paths (angelic/favorable opportunity sequence)
notClaimed: eventual completion under every fair schedule
likelihood under S05 marginal edge weights
schedulerQuantification.reason: self-loops permit indefinite avoidance and S05 projects away counter-addressed history; universal, probabilistic, and byte-exact quantities require separate estimands

edgeSemantics.selfLoops: retained in source; removable from an existential optimum because every secondary profile has strictly positive activation cost and loops cannot lower the vertex maximum
edgeSemantics.parallelEdges: retained and separately eligible; primary endpoint-only excursion may tie, while action labels and secondary costs may differ
edgeSemantics.witnessIdentity: ordered S05 authoritative edge keys; deterministic witness selection does not imply uniqueness

secondaryCosts.ordering: lexicographic after the primary excursion is fixed at its exact optimum
secondaryCosts.method: first solve the bottleneck; then restrict to vertices at or below the optimal absolute bottleneck and solve a nonnegative additive lexicographic shortest path
secondaryCosts.properness: every profile includes activations, so every edge has a lexicographically positive cost and an optimal finite cycle-free witness exists

solver.primaryAlgorithm: reverse directed integer-bucket minimax search from all complete goals, one family at a time
solver.primaryComplexity: O(V+E+L) time and O(V+E+L) working memory for L distinct integer levels
solver.secondaryAlgorithm: forward lexicographic Dijkstra inside the optimal bottleneck sublevel set for a requested start/profile
solver.secondaryComplexity: O((V+E) log V) worst case per requested witness
solver.proofObligation: a combined single-label (peak,cost) Dijkstra is forbidden because a temporarily higher peak with lower cost can become preferable when both paths later cross a common higher level

observedComparisonConventions: same S04 family identity and complete structural start including Selection cursors
project every observed action to an exact S05 authoritative edge key
same goal, direction, metric numerator, terminal precedence, and cost profile
charge no-ops and rejections exactly as S05 edges
record event-budget stopping as censoring rather than quiescence or graph unreachability
label the optimum existential structural-opportunity, not byte-exact or likely-scheduler
preserve many-to-one replay-history to structural-state projection provenance
report ties among optimal paths; a deterministic witness is not a uniqueness claim

scopeBoundary.s06: definition, reusable solver, proof sketches, fixtures, all-family compatibility audit, and feasibility benchmarks only
scopeBoundary.deferredToS07: scientific prevalence tables and all-state optimal/minimax path solutions over the complete corpus

escalationBoundaries.rule: stop and report any incompatible family, missing goal, schema mismatch, proof/solver disagreement, or working-set overflow; do not omit a family or change semantics

validationGates: hand-solvable complete, monotone, necessary, avoidable, unreachable, and quiescent fixtures
multiple tied goals and goal-distance compatibility
self-loop and parallel-edge invariance with secondary-cost discrimination
independent exhaustive simple-path brute force on deterministic tiny multigraphs
primary witness replay and bottleneck equality
secondary witness replay and exact additive cost equality
all 7,984 S05 families retain compatible node/edge/goal metadata
all family goal counts equal complete-node counts
all exact S05 metric numerators fit the declared solver domain
largest-node and largest-edge family ingestion and runtime benchmarks
